summary: P0-F.7 Campaign Story validated end-to-end. Ran the 9 unit tests in /app/backend/tests/edr/test_p0_f7_campaign_story.py (9/9 pass) and added a new live preview-URL integration suite /app/backend/tests/edr/test_p0_f7_live_api.py covering all 8 review points (14/14 pass). Frontend UI validated with Playwright against the deployed preview URL — every advertised data-testid is present, all 15 activities render, expand shows the full provenance chain + evidence-state chips + evidence-plane epistemic note, response block shows 5 correlated actions with 2 VERIFIED KILL_PROCESS and the CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE/VERIFICATION_FAILED ones NOT presented as success, gaps + pivots rendered, sidebar Campaign Story tab exists and preserves the OPENED FROM INCIDENT banner, empty-state (no incident_id) and error-state (bogus incident_id: 'no incident … in this tenant') both correct. Regression pages /edr/process-tree and /xdr/admin/edr-response still load and work.
critical_code_review_comments: campaign_story.py is a strict projection — no writes, no verdict recomputation, all six-state vocabulary honoured, canonical id divergence surfaced as an explicit gap rather than hidden. No issues.
EdrCampaignStoryPage.jsx correctly renders backend fields verbatim; no derived verdicts, no fabricated statuses. No issues.

Minor (non-blocking): /app/backend/conftest.py force-sets DB_NAME=nivxray_ci_local, which shadows the .env-configured DB when running live-preview tests. New test file loads .env with override=True to work around this; consider making conftest respect a pre-existing DB_NAME or introducing a marker for live-preview tests.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only against the real INC000000231/inc_c253027ba781494684db incident; verified repeated GETs create no new collections.
